title: Feynman and Wheeler's 1945 paper on time-symmetric electromagnetism

tellings.quote: theory Richard feineman in 1945 wrote a key paper with wheeler

plain: In 1945 the physicists Richard Feynman and John Wheeler wrote a key paper on electromagnetism in which influences could run backward as well as forward in time. The biologist Rupert Sheldrake brings it up in passing, without naming the paper, as part of a theory he is laying out. He uses it to suggest that mainstream physics has already allowed for effects that do not only move forward in time.
